events.title: Macbeth – Shake & Stir Theatre Co.
events.location: QPAC – Lyric Theatre / Playhouse, South Brisbane
events.description: Shake & Stir Theatre Co presents Shakespeare's tragedy, Macbeth, a bold reimagining for its 20th anniversary. Enjoy a gripping theatrical performance.

events.title: Opera Queensland: Rusalka
events.datetime: Opens Thu 25 Jun 2026 (multiple sessions this week)
events.description: Opera Queensland presents the grand-scale opera Rusalka, inspired by The Little Mermaid, a shimmering tale of love and transformation. It opens in QPAC's new Glasshouse Theatre.

events.title: Queensland Ballet: Hamlet
events.description: Queensland Ballet presents Hamlet, a gripping dance drama by choreographer Leo Mujić, exploring themes of love, power, and corruption.

events.title: Queensland Ballet: Red Riding Hood and the Wolf
events.location: Queensland Performing Arts Centre, South Brisbane
events.description: Queensland Ballet presents a brand-new, whimsical production of Red Riding Hood and the Wolf, designed to enchant young audiences and families.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights: Olafur Eliasson: Presence (Final Night)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: The final GOMA Friday Night event offers a unique social experience within the multi-sensory Olafur Eliasson exhibition, featuring DJs, live performances, drinks, and bites.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence (Exhibition)
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Experience Olafur Eliasson: Presence, a landmark multi-sensory art installation exclusive to GOMA, challenging perceptions of light, space, and perspective.

events.title: QAGOMA: Australian Cinémathèque Film Screening
events.description: The Australian Cinémathèque offers unique film and video screenings, providing an opportunity to see diverse and rare cinematic works not widely shown elsewhere.

events.title: QAGOMA: Australian Cinémathèque Film Screening
events.description: The Australian Cinémathèque offers unique film and video screenings, providing an opportunity to see diverse and rare cinematic works not widely shown elsewhere.

events.title: QAGOMA: Curator-led Guided Tour
events.description: Participate in a curator-led guided tour at QAG, offering deeper insights into current exhibitions and the stories behind the artworks.

events.title: Lifeline Brisbane Bookfest
events.location: Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre (BCEC), South Brisbane
events.description: A beloved community event, the Lifeline Bookfest returns for nine days, offering a treasure hunt through thousands of second-hand books and a comic-fest section.

events.title: Game Changers: In Conversation with Lea Ea of ARROWES
events.location: State Library of Queensland / QUT, South Brisbane
events.description: Innovation leader Lea Ea of ARROWES shares insights with aspiring entrepreneurs in this Game Changers series, facilitated by ABC Brisbane's Kat Feeney.

events.title: SLQ Explainer Series
events.location: The Edge, State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: The Explainer Series offers thoughtful conversations with experts on a range of topics from international law to climate change and gut health, providing context and insight.

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026 (Brisbane Airport)
events.description: A selection from the World Press Photo Exhibition is on display, showcasing powerful stories through photojournalism at the Domestic Terminal, accessible to a broader audience.

events.title: Archie Moore: kith and kin (Exhibition)
events.description: Experience kith and kin by Archie Moore, an immersive installation that explores the common ancestors of all life, emphasizing our shared kinship and responsibilities.

events.title: Tom Gleeson: Out of Touch Tour
events.description: Enjoy a night of stand-up comedy with Tom Gleeson, one of Australia's sharpest comedians, as he brings his "Out of Touch" tour to Brisbane.

events.title: Queensland Symphony Orchestra Concert
events.description: Experience some of the greatest music ever written, performed by the Queensland Symphony Orchestra as part of their 2026 National Concert Season at QPAC.

events.title: The God of Small Things: Faith and Popular Culture (Exhibition)
events.description: This exhibition at GOMA explores the intersection of faith and popular culture, offering a unique perspective on contemporary artistic expression.
